articles.title: LSU news: SEC wants authority to 'expel' Tigers from league in latest lawsuit
articles.summary: LSU got off to a great start to the season, defeating Clemson 51-10. Prior to the game, a court ruling cleared the way for Dae’Quan Wright and Zxavian Harris...
articles.body:
LSU got off to a great start to the season, defeating Clemson 51-10. Prior to the game, a court ruling cleared the way for Dae'Quan Wright and Zxavian Harris, both players who participated in NFL camps, to play. The SEC issued a warning to LSU and head coach Lane Kiffin not to play those players. Kiffin decided against placing Harris and Wright on the roster for their opening game, saying it was in the best interest of the program.

Now, the SEC, which has already filed a lawsuit against LSU, is amending the suit to make sure those players stay off the field, per Pete Thamel of ESPN.

"The SEC filed an amendment to its federal lawsuit against LSU, Lane Kiffin and school officials on Tuesday, which seeks the authority for the SEC to expel LSU from the league. The SEC is not expected to take such action, but the filing indicates the seriousness of the league as it attempts to affirm the legal right to enforce its own rules. That was the point of the original federal suit filed last week," Thamel posted on X, formerly Twitter.

Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial)

The SEC wants to ensure that Greg Sankey , the commissioner of the SEC, and the conference itself can enforce its own rules. The statement from the SEC states their goal is to protect the conference and its ability to govern .

"Today, the Southeastern Conference, headquartered in Birmingham, Alabama, filed a request for a temporary restraining order in the United States District Court for the Northern District of Alabama to protect the right of the Conference and its member institutions to govern themselves. The SEC and its member universities have the right to establish, through agreed-upon governance procedures, the rules under which they voluntarily compete and to expect those rules to be followed." The statement read. "A commitment to those rules, and to the core principles of the Southeastern Conference, is an essential element of SEC membership. Today's filing is necessary to defend that right and preserve the Conference's ability to govern competition among its members."

It is extremely rare for a conference to take such action against a school as expulsion, but it has happened in the past. The Big East expelled Temple in 2004 due to a lack of commitment to football. Meanwhile, the SEC has already scheduled a meeting to determine the future of LSU, according to Ross Dellenger of Yahoo Sports.

"Pursuant to notice properly given under Section 5.1 contemporaneously with the filing of this First Amended Complaint, the CEOs will meet on September 10, 2026, to decide whether to terminate Louisiana State University ("LSU") as an SEC member institution pursuant to Section 3.1.5 of the SEC Constitution and Bylaws," Dellinger quoted the SEC as filing.

LSU currently has no comment on the situation, according to Dellinger.

As the court battle continues, LSU could still face significant punishment if it decided to play Harris and Wrigh t. LSU is scheduled to open up conference play on September 19 on the road against Ole Miss.

Reports linking Celtic striker Camilo Duran with a sensational move to Manchester United have been dismissed as false.

Camilo Duran of Celtic celebrates scoring his team's first goal during the Scottish Premiership 2026/27 match between Celtic and Aberdeen at Celtic Park on September 02, 2026. (Photo by Ian MacNicol/Getty Images)

Claims emerging from Azerbaijan had suggested the Premier League giants were monitoring Duran following his blistering start to life at Parkhead.

The speculation came as something of a surprise given the Colombian only joined Celtic from Qarabag for around £6million in July and is just eight games into his Hoops career.

However, Scottish-Azerbaijani journalist Fuad Alakbarov has since stated that the reports connecting Duran with an Old Trafford move have been proven to be false.

Notably, the claims were not picked up by outlets in Colombia, Scotland or England despite suggesting one of the world's biggest clubs had already taken an interest in the Celtic striker.

Duran has made an immediate impact under Martin O'Neill, registering nine goal involvements across his opening eight appearances and quickly establishing himself as a key figure in the Celtic attack.

His explosive start will inevitably attract attention if it continues, but Hoops supporters can breathe easily over the latest speculation, with the Manchester United links appearing to have no substance.

articles.title: When do MLB playoffs start? 2026 postseason and World Series schedule
articles.summary: MLB's postseason could run all the way through Halloween. See the full schedule.
articles.body:
Major League Baseball's 2026 playoffs get underway on Sept. 29 , two days after the conclusion of the regular season, with the best-of-three wild card series proceeding the best-of-five division series that begin the next weekend.

This is the fifth year with baseball's new postseason format that includes three division winners and three wild card teams from each league. The third-ranked division winner and the wild card teams face off in the three-game series that are hosted by the teams with the better records.

The best-of-seven League Championship Series begin on Monday, Oct. 11 (National League) and Tuesday, Oct. 12 (American). The 2026 World Series begins on Friday, Oct. 23, with home-field advantage for the best best-of-seven Fall Classic going to the team with the better regular season record. If the World Series goes the distance, Game 7 is scheduled for Saturday, Oct. 31.

The Los Angeles Dodgers have won the World Series two years in a row and are seeking to become the first NL team to ever three-peat.

The best-of-three AL and NL wild-card playoffs will begin with all four series playing on the same days. The division winners with the worst overall record in each league, along with the wild-card teams with the best record in each league will host all games.

The best-of-five AL and NL division series will open with all four series on the same day. However, the AL and NL games will be staggered going forward.

articles.title: Dan Campbell Accidentally Leaks Tom Kennedy News
articles.summary: Dan Campbell accidentally revealed Tuesday that Tom Kennedy will play for the Detroit Lions in their Week 1 matchup against New Orleans.
articles.body:
Dan Campbell apparently had one piece of the Detroit Lions' Week 1 plan he was not quite ready to make public.

Campbell confirmed Tuesday that veteran wide receiver Tom Kennedy will play Sunday against the New Orleans Saints, according to Ben Raven of MLive. Campbell immediately realized he had revealed more than intended.

"Tom Kennedy is playing in this game … 'Oh s***' (realizing he gave that one away)."

The comment answers one question while creating another. Kennedy currently resides on Detroit's practice squad after the Lions officially brought him back following final roster cuts , meaning Detroit must either elevate him for Sunday or move him onto the 53-man roster.

A permanent promotion would make plenty of sense. Detroit entered the week with two open roster spots, and after promoting Joe Bachie on Monday, one opening remains on the active roster . Kennedy was already identified as the most obvious candidate when the Lions initially created those vacancies .

His value goes beyond providing a fifth receiver.

Kennedy emerged as a legitimate return option last season, averaging 27.9 yards per kickoff return and 16.7 yards per punt return. Detroit's training camp breakdown of the receiver competition specifically highlighted that production along with Kennedy's versatility and the trust he has built during Campbell's tenure.

That matters after Detroit moved on from Greg Dortch and kept only Amon-Ra St. Brown, Jameson Williams, Isaac TeSlaa and Tay Martin on the initial active roster. Brad Holmes had already indicated that the practice-squad receivers remained very much part of Detroit's plans .

Campbell just removed most of the mystery surrounding Kennedy.

What remains unclear is whether Detroit plans to use a standard practice-squad elevation or fill its final open roster spot. It is also not yet known whether Kennedy's primary job Sunday will be at receiver, in the return game or both.

articles.title: Birmingham City forward expected to miss Norwich game
articles.summary: Birmingham City are set to be without Demarai Gray for Wednesday’s clash with Norwich City.Gray came off the bench with 20 minutes remaining of Sunday’s 2-2...
articles.body:
Birmingham City are set to be without Demarai Gray for Wednesday's clash with Norwich City.

Gray came off the bench with 20 minutes remaining of Sunday's 2-2 draw with Wolves but could not finish the game.

The 30-year-old has recently been managing a shoulder problem, initially raising fears he had aggravated the injury.

But Gray indicated to Birmingham boss Chris Davies as he left the pitch that he was feeling unwell rather than struggling with his shoulder.

"He's OK," Davies said. "He did take a bit of a knock and he wasn't feeling very well, so he's not really been training.

"He's being assessed by the doctors and things so it's unlikely that he will be involved tomorrow night as he continues to recover from that."

articles.title: Lakers predicted to trade for Clippers' $48M elite 3-and-D wing to pair with Luka Doncic
articles.summary: The Los Angeles Lakers are in major need of a power forward. A Lakers insider brought to life someone they should put all of their chips in a bag for in a po...
articles.body:
The Los Angeles Lakers have not been the most successful team this summer when it comes to landing the players they have targeted in free agency. LA has missed out on some big-time free agents, but it has also landed several players it wanted, so the offseason has not been all bad.

The Lakers were on the hunt for Jonathan Kuminga for two months. In the end, he decided to sign with the Minnesota Timberwolves.

"The Minnesota Timberwolves today announced the team has signed. forward Jonathan Kuminga. Per team policy, terms of the agreement were not released. Kuminga, 23, wrapped up his fifth season in the NBA, splitting time between the Atlanta Hawks and Golden State Warriors after being traded to the Hawks on Feb. 5," the organization wrote. "Kuminga will wear #24 for the Timberwolves."

With Kuminga signing in Minnesota, that left a hole in the Lakers' starting lineup. The power forward position is not a strong spot for Los Angeles right now, leaving the team searching for a player who can step into the starting role.

"Then, there is the power forward position. This is the last domino among the starting lineup that really does not have full clarity just yet. There are certainly players internally, and even externally, who could fill the vacancy," Lake Show Life's Svyatoslav Rovenchuk wrote.

Lakers insider Jovan Buha may be onto something. In a recent mailbag, he suggested that the Lakers pursue a trade for P.J. Washington. However, he also mentioned Derrick Jones Jr. as someone the team should consider acquiring.

"Pursue the upgrade now, and specifically a starting level player. I think PJ Washington is a starter on a good team that wants to compete with San Antonio and OKC. I do think PJ Washington and Derrick Jones Jr. would be great fits," Buha said.

Jones Jr. would be a great fit for what the Lakers need. He could play up at the power forward position while bringing plenty of defensive versatility to the table.

He has made $48 million throughout his career. LA needs a lengthy and versatile player, and Jones Jr. fits that mold. He is also a capable shooter from beyond the arc, which would give Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves another reliable option on the floor.
